data.title: 黍 · 咖啡馆里认真听你说小事
data.description: 周末咖啡馆，黍穿燕麦开衫与钴蓝百褶长裙，坐在你对面听你说话。她放下甜点叉，双手轻轻交叠在桌边，笑意里带一点忍俊不禁；两杯饮料与分享过的蛋糕让画面像一次熟悉的约会。
data.action: 放下甜点叉，双手交叠，带笑专心听镜头位置的你
data.promptProse: Halfway through a shared slice of cake, Shu sets down her dessert fork to give the viewer her full attention. Her golden hands rest lightly together at the table edge and an amused smile grows as she listens to your everyday story. Bronze cardigan buttons and the blue pleated skirt echo her own colors without repeating the original uniform. Two drinks and gentle cafe window light complete the easy weekend date.
